summary: You can now undo commits, restore from backups, pause the daily reconcile and release guards under full control.

new.title: Undo any commit
new.text: Commit history & undo shows every commit with who, when and what changed. A SuperAdmin can undo any commit, an Admin their own, through the normal approvals.

new.title: Back up and restore your configuration
new.text: A daily backup and Back up now keep your configuration for 90 days, never secrets. A SuperAdmin restores the rows they pick as a normal, undoable change.

new.title: Pause the daily reconcile
new.text: A SuperAdmin can pause it with a reason and an optional end time, shown on Home and Jobs. Commits and Run now keep working.

new.title: See and release guards
new.text: Guards shows what each protective guard is holding. A SuperAdmin can release that exact plan, with a reason, for one run or up to 24 hours.

new.title: Remove from PIM on Admin accounts
new.text: Removes every delegation of an admin and disables the account, but keeps it.

fixes.title: Clear rules for deleting admin accounts
fixes.text: A SuperAdmin or Admin may delete any admin; a delegated operator only admins at or below its own level and tier.

fixes.title: Self-approval covers disable and offboarding
fixes.text: With self-approval on, a disable or offboarding commits directly and is recorded as self-approved.

fixes.title: Results recorded per item
fixes.text: Each commit's result in the tenant is now recorded per item: created, updated, removed, already present or failed.
